    INNER JOIN [Users] AS [u] ON [c].[InstructorId] = [u].[Id]
    WHERE [c].[Id] = @__id_0
) AS [t]
LEFT JOIN [Reviews] AS [r] ON [t].[Id] = [r].[CourseId]
ORDER BY [t].[Id], [t].[Id0], [t].[Id1]
